title: Grilled Fennel with American Cheese
description: A simple and flavorful side dish that highlights the sweetness of fennel paired with the creaminess of American cheese.
instructions: Brush fennel slices with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Grill fennel for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and lightly charred.
Meanwhile, toast American cheese slices by placing them on the grill for 30 seconds on each side.
Assemble the dish by placing a grilled fennel slice on a plate, topping with a toasted American cheese slice, and sprinkling with chopped nuts.
